violations.description: Duties of person in charge. — --Person in charge did not ensure employee compliance with an aspect of the food service operation specified in the food service code. Food service manager did not ensure compliance with hand washing and sanitizing requirements.

General employee cleanliness. — --Food employee did not wash hands as necessary. Observed employee just using hand sanitizer in between tasks and not washing hands. Hand sanitizer is not a substitute for hand washing.

General equipment and utensils - Materials and design. — --Material of nonfood contact surface was not constructed or designed to be smooth, nonabsorbent and cleanable. The wood placed on the plastic shelving was bare wood. The edges of the shelving above the three compartment sink was bare wood on the edges. These are not a cleanable surface and should be painted or sealed. Plastic utensils and portion cups were being stored in paper cups and cardboard boxes. These must be replaced with items that can be cleaned.

Manual cleaning and sanitizing requirements. — --An approved sanitizer was not used during three compartment sink operation. An employee washed a blender pitcher with just soap. Sanitizer was not used. An approved sanitizer must be used to sanitize dishes.--Employee observed washing hands in a warewash sink. Employee stated they use the ware wash sink to wash hands and not the front hand sink. The designated hand sink needs to be used for hand washing.

Mechanical cleaning and sanitizing requirements. — --Warewash machine was not maintained and/or operated as required. A tub with soap for washing dishes was placed in the middle sink of the three compartment sink. A rack and crate were placed in the third compartment. This is not being used in the wash, rinse, sanitize method for cleaning and sanitizing dishes.

Single-service and single-use articles. — --Single-service item was not stored, handled, dispensed in a manner to protect from contamination. Plastic knives and spoons in the paper cups in the back were being stored with the food contact surface facing up. These must be stored with the handles facing up.
Handwashing lavatory supplies. — --Handwash lavatory was not supplied with supply of hand cleaning liquid, powder or bar soap. Soap was not provided for the front hand sink.
Toilet facilities. — --Toilet room was not provided with a tight fitting or self closing door. The bathroom door in the back was not self closing.

Design and construction of floors, walls, and ceilings. — --Exposed studs, joists or rafters were not covered with smooth, nonabsorbent and easily cleanable material. The wall behind the ice machine up front has exposed studs and is not covered with a cleanable material.
